en: The image depicts a historical view of a small town nestled at the foot of green hills. The town features neoclassical and traditional Mediterranean architecture with red-tiled roofs, low-rise buildings, and a few trees scattered around. There is a prominent building in the foreground with columns and a balcony. The upper right corner contains bilingual text in Greek and English, and the bottom right has a watermark from a Greek website.
